id="ADR-0003" title="Develop SDK, harness, and ADK layers in one repo; defer repo split" status="Accepted" inferred=false
author="Donald Gifford" created="2026-07-02"
summary=""
context="The original plan was two artifacts in two places: this repo as the \"lower-level\" framewor…"
decision="**All layers — framework SDK, loop harness, and future ADK components — develop in thi…"
consequences positive=4 negative=3 neutral=2
alternatives=3 open-questions=0 references=6

positive line=117
  text="Atomic cross-layer changes while both surfaces churn — no release/pin/bump cycle between the core and the harness; RFC-0001's \"framework churn breaks the ADK\" risk largely dissolves."

positive line=120
  text="One docz suite (IDs keep cross-referencing), one CI, one set of conventions, one `CLAUDE.md`."

positive line=122
  text="Fastest path to the actual goal: donald-loop workloads running, without repo-plumbing work in front of it."

positive line=124
  text="INV-0007's sub-module analysis gets adopted as living guidance instead of dying with the Copilot pivot."

negative line=131
  text="Root-module `go.sum` growth must be watched — the escalation rule (rule 3) is the containment, and it requires discipline to apply _when_ a heavy dep lands, not after consumers already carry it."

negative line=134
  text="CI blast radius: every layer shares the gate. Acceptable at current scale; a future path-filtered matrix is available if `just ci` gets slow."

negative line=136
  text="If the public-release trigger fires, the split becomes a bigger one-time event than it would have been with pre-separated repos. Accepted: that event may never come, and the layering rules bound its cost."

neutral line=144
  text="The private-repo posture (INV-0001 Q1) now covers all layers equally."

neutral line=145
  text="RFC-0001 remains the ADK's product definition; only its placement assumption changes. Its phases still gate on their own prerequisites."

alternative line=153 label="" title="Two repos now (original implicit plan)."
  text="Rejected: pays the version-pinning and compat tax at peak churn, for a boundary we can't y…"

alternative line=157 label="" title="One repo, sub-modules everywhere from day one."
  text="Rejected: INV-0007 itself documents the release-ordering and CI overhead of multi-module r…"

alternative line=161 label="" title="Harness here, ADK in its own repo later regardless."
  text="Rejected as a standing commitment — it re-creates the churn tax the moment ADK work star…"
